meta.name: convert-documents-to-markdown
meta.description: Convert an attached Word document, presentation, spreadsheet, OpenDocument file, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF into local Markdown. Use when a message supplies a local attachment path that must be read without uploading it to an external parser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要把办公文档转成Markdown格式
copy.tagline_en: Turn office documents into local Markdown
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need office documents as Markdown

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能把消息里附带的本地文档（Word、PPT、表格、PDF、EPUB、CSV 等）在容器内转成 Markdown，并告诉你生成的输出路径。转换在本地进行，不上传外部解析服务。
howto.when: 当消息里给出了本地附件路径，需要在不外传的前提下读取这份文档时触发。

say.text: 这份扫描版 PDF 转出来是空的，帮我说明哪里不支持
say.note: 会如实报告图片型输入等失败原因

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude converts a locally attached document (Word, presentation, spreadsheet, PDF, EPUB, CSV, etc.) into Markdown inside the agent container and reports the output path. Conversion stays local; nothing is uploaded to an external parser.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a message supplies a local attachment path that must be read without uploading it to an external parser.

say_en.note: Converts in the container and prints the output path

say_en.text: This scanned PDF converted to nothing; tell me why it's unsupported
say_en.note: Reports image-only input and other failure causes
Reads CSV from stdin and names the format
